en.p: In the coordinate plane there is an equilateral triangle $\mathrm{ABC}$ with side length $4$. Let $\mathrm{D}$, $\mathrm{E}$, $\mathrm{F}$ be the points that internally divide segments $\mathrm{AB}$, $\mathrm{BC}$, $\mathrm{CA}$ in the ratio $1:3$, respectively. Four points $\mathrm{P}$, $\mathrm{Q}$, $\mathrm{R}$, $\mathrm{X}$ satisfy the following conditions.
When the value of $\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm{AX}}\right|$ is at its maximum, let $S$ be the area of triangle $\mathrm{PQR}$. Find the value of $16S^{2}$. [4 points]
